$comment: Manifest entries for `illustrate`, read by src/lib/manifest-parts.ts (and by `manifest --json`). Names resolve from the files they point to, so the list cannot drift.

commands.name: illustrate
commands.summary: The brand's own drawing style as code: the globe, its dome, the cube cut into cells, the cog node, the loader, or a picture framed in a window. Writes SVG (every line and node a vector shape) and PNG. Same subject, settings and seed give the same bytes.
commands.unknownName: exits 1 and names the nearest choices
